description: Reads the public robots.txt of a website (one request to https://<host>/robots.txt, nothing else on the site) and says, for each AI crawler and AI agent of the migurei bot registry (training crawlers such as GPTBot and ClaudeBot, search bots, fetchers that act for a user, and others), whether that bot is allowed or disallowed for the path "/", which robots.txt rule decided it, and whether the file exists. Each bot also carries observed_on_pw: the counts our own lab site pw.migurei.ai recorded for that bot (published on https://pw.migurei.ai/ja/research/ai-bot-first-visits; the same for every domain, not about the domain asked, not a prediction). Input is a domain or URL; only public domain names are accepted (no IP addresses, no ports, no private hosts). Read-only; the domain is not stored. robots.txt is a request to bots, not access control, and a User-Agent is only a claim.

domain.description: A public domain name or a URL, for example example.com or https://example.com/page. Only its host is used.

name: check_ai_bot_access

observed_on_pw.description: What our lab saw this bot do on its own site pw.migurei.ai (counts published on the source page). Not about the domain asked, not a prediction. The same for every domain asked.

title: Check which AI bots a site allows
